name: auto-handoff
description: Writes a cold-start handoff to handoff/, switches to a fresh context at a natural checkpoint past a soft threshold, carries the handoff into every compaction, and offers to resume from it in the next session.

softThreshold.title: Soft threshold (%)
softThreshold.description: Past this fill, look for a natural checkpoint after each turn and switch to a fresh context there. /autohandoff soft <n> overrides it.

step.title: Checkpoint check step (%)
step.description: Ask the model whether this is a checkpoint at most once per this many points of context growth. /autohandoff step <n> overrides it.

threshold.title: Hard threshold (%)
threshold.description: Write a handoff without switching once the context window is this full, even mid-task. /autohandoff hard <n> overrides it.

autoSwitch.title: Switch at checkpoints
autoSwitch.description: Compact to a fresh context with the handoff at a checkpoint past the soft threshold. /autohandoff switch on|off overrides it.

enabled.title: Automatic handoffs
enabled.description: Write handoffs automatically and carry them into compactions. /autohandoff on|off overrides it.
